occurrence of series

  • CURIE: gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/occurrenceOfSeries
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/events

Relates a concrete event occurrence to the series that issued it; the inverse of gmeow:seriesOccurrence.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Event -> gmeow:EventSeries

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries from gmeow:Event to gmeow:EventSeries when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Event, gmeow:EventSeries
